dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent O-shaped rings exhibit a sharp transition from the dark brown dorsal pelage to a light gray circular perimeter. These rings are distributed along the mid-lateral section, with some exhibiting an incomplete 'C' shape where the perimeter gradient is interrupted. The centers of these rings maintain the low-intensity value of the surrounding base fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid light-intensity pixels is concentrated on the anterior dorsal and neck regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and form an asymmetrical, stippled pattern with very short inter-centroid distances.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form a scalene triangle. A separate grouping of four high-intensity blobs in the posterior region forms a localized trapezoidal geometric relationship.
